English.Char_Desc_2000: Yutovo is an application for solving various mathematical problems. Yutovo has a visual "paper" view for calculations. It uses a generally accepted mathematical syntax to display formulas. Yutovo is designed to solve everyday and engineering problems and can be used by different people and for different jobs. • Yutovo uses a graphical representation of mathematical formulas. • Calculation results can have any number of digits and accuracy. • Yutovo works with the following types of numbers: real, integer, fractional, complex. • The measure of an angle can be changed. • Commonly used mathematical functions and constants are supported. • User variables and functions are supported. • Yutovo uses units and unit systems and can translate values ​​between them. • Automatic recalculation of expressions helps users observe the results of calculations when editing formulas. • Syntax highlighting. • A library of examples and visual documentation.
